summary: End-to-end backend+frontend test of CCAUVERY college app. Backend: 37/40 pytest cases passed (38/40 after test-side email lowercase fix). Frontend: all public pages load, all 3 role logins redirect correctly, dashboards render, admission/contact/register/mark-attendance flows work. Two real backend bugs found (500 errors) on admin-create-course and faculty-upload-material due to duplicate Pydantic kwargs. Fee payment backend API works; UI 'pay' toggle not verified visually (minor).

critical.issue: 500 Internal Server Error. server.py line 290: `Course(**data.model_dump(), code=data.code.upper())` passes 'code' twice. Fix: `course = Course(**{**data.model_dump(), 'code': data.code.upper()})` OR mutate data.code before unpacking. Reproduced via backend pytest AND admin UI (React error overlay shows 'Request failed with status code 500').

500 Internal Server Error. server.py line 430: `Material(**data.model_dump(), uploaded_by=user['email'])` - MaterialIn already includes optional 'uploaded_by' so kwarg collision occurs when Pydantic emits the field (even if None) via model_dump(). Fix: `Material(**{**data.model_dump(exclude={'uploaded_by'}), 'uploaded_by': user['email']})`. Backend traceback confirmed in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking 'Add' after filling new-course form triggers an uncaught runtime error overlay (due to backend 500). Frontend should catch axios error and show inline error instead of uncaught promise rejection.

After clicking 'Pay' the fee row status did not visibly update to 'Paid' in my scripted test (status text 'Paid' not found in body). Backend POST /api/fees/{id}/pay returns 200 OK, so UI likely does not refetch/update local state after payment. Needs visual re-verification.

integration_issues.issue: Axios error not caught; React error overlay appears in dev mode.

action_items: FIX server.py line 290: duplicate 'code' kwarg in create_course -> use exclude or set data.code pre-unpack.
FIX server.py line 430: duplicate 'uploaded_by' kwarg in create_material -> use model_dump(exclude={'uploaded_by'}).
Wrap admin/faculty create calls in try/catch in frontend to show toast/inline error instead of uncaught promise.
Verify StudentDashboard Fees 'Pay' button actually re-renders the fee as 'paid' (refetch on success).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 795 lines — acceptable but getting close to the 700-line split threshold. Consider splitting routes into modules (auth, academics, admin).
seed_admin() correctly re-hashes password if changed — good pattern.
create_course uppercases code AFTER unpacking -> duplicate kwarg bug. Same pattern risk in create_material.
CORS allow_credentials=True combined with allow_origins='*' (default) is not valid per spec — browsers will refuse to send cookies. If cookie auth is expected, set explicit origins.
POST /api/fees/{id}/pay is documented as mocked — OK and explicitly stated in docstring.
PATCH /api/admissions uses query param `status_value` (not body) — non-standard REST; documented but confusing.
All responses properly exclude _id via projection. Good.
JWT_SECRET is read from env but has no default — fails fast (good).
No password complexity check beyond min_length=6 on register.
data-testid coverage is good across dashboards and forms.

rca of the issue: Both 500 errors share root cause: Pydantic sub-model (CourseIn/MaterialIn) declares a field that is ALSO being passed explicitly as a kwarg after unpacking model_dump(). Python raises TypeError: got multiple values for keyword argument. Fix by either (a) excluding the field from model_dump() before unpacking, or (b) mutating data.code = data.code.upper() before constructing Course and only unpacking. Reproduction: POST /api/courses with admin token and body {code:'ZZZ',name:'X',duration:'1',description:'d',eligibility:'e'} -> 500. Backend log shows exact TypeError at server.py:290.
